title: Starting — pre-flight checks
blurb: Parallel health checks (database, SAP AI Core, Gmail) run before any fetching. If a required system is unreachable the run aborts here.

title: Collecting — fetch from sources
blurb: Pulls new items from every configured source (RSS, Twitter/X, crawled URL sources, email inbox). Each source is anchored to its own last-fetch date so nothing is re-pulled.

title: Filtering — drop stale / irrelevant
blurb: Applies each source's date window (lookback). The old binary keep/drop filter is retired — relevance is now enforced by the ranker's Rank 1 (Noise) tier, which scores items but never emails noise.

title: Attributing — issuing authority
blurb: Stamps each item's publisher and authority. Configured feeds match directly; feeds with no configured authority get an AI-inferred one (flagged in Review).

title: Comparing — dedupe & detect change
blurb: Classifies each item against the baseline as New, Update (with delta), Repeated (with count), or Duplicate. Duplicates are kept at rank 0, never dropped.

title: Analyzing — rank & tag
blurb: A three-tier engine (deterministic signals, then grounded GPT-4o) scores significance 1–5. Glossary tagging then assigns topic labels and flags significant items the glossary can't explain. Email is sent only for rank ≥ threshold (default 3); a glossary match floors an item at rank 2.

ranks.meaning: Enacted legislation with immediate compliance effect
Relevant case law or indirect implication
Off-topic / macro / finance, no direct HR obligation

title: Sending — email digest
blurb: Items at or above the rank threshold (default 3) are composed into an AI-grouped HTML digest and sent via Gmail on a separate thread. Skipped in test mode; resendable on failure.

title: Done — run complete
blurb: Results are saved and visible in Review immediately. The email send runs afterward on its own thread; human review is asynchronous and never blocks the run.
